This Writ Petition has been filed for a Certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records of the 1st respondent in proceeding No.S.R.7/2020/U2 dated 08.01.2022 quash the same and consequently direct the 1st respondent to re-determine the compensation at the rate of Rs.1810/- per Sq.meters to the petitioner's land in Survey No.448/2 an extent of 714 Sq.meters is situated at A.Reddihalli Village, Dharmapuri Taluk & District, on the basis of higher compensation awarded by the respondents to the neighboring lands in Survey No.448/3B and 448/5D.
2.
Aggrieved by the Order passed by the 1st Respondent dated 08.01.2022, the Petitioner has filed the present Writ Petition.
_____ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
The Petitioner seeks to question the Order passed by the 1 st Respondent under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
The said Act contemplates the application of the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 to the Arbitration under this Act.
4. Under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, the 1 st Respondent discharges the functions of an Arbitrator.
A Remedy is only by way of an application under Section 34 to the Competent Court.

The Petitioner cannot take out an application seeking a direction to the 1st Respondent to once again review the Award passed by him which is treated as an Award under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
5. Therefore, the Writ Petition is dismissed.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
